277005240.description: This Royal Danish Briar tobacco pipe is made in Denmark and features a rusticated black and brown briar wood bowl with smooth natural grain highlights. The bent stem is black and adorned with a crown logo, suggesting a specific brand or manufacturer. The interior chamber shows darkening, and the exterior has minor wear from handling. This pipe is a collectible item suitable for enthusiasts of vintage smoking accessories.

277316139.description: This vintage collection includes seven small clear specimen containers, each holding a different mineral or rock sample in colors such as clear, amber, green, brown, and yellow. The containers and lids show signs of age and dust accumulation, suggesting long-term storage. Additionally, there is one larger loose mineral specimen that is rough, translucent, and light pink in color, possibly rose quartz. No brand or manufacturer markings are visible on any of the items.

277181045.description:
Unopened whole geode packaged for breaking open at home. The tan and cream stone has a bumpy, nodular outer surface with gray mineral speckling and a small pink paint dot on one side. It arrives sealed in clear plastic wrap with a printed card from Stoneworks Lapidary titled Break Your Own Geode, noting that these geodes are found in Morocco and instructing the user to tap moderately with a hammer until they crack open to reveal the crystal structure inside, wrapping the stone in a cloth or wearing safety glasses first. Includes the geode, the wrap and the instruction card. The interior has not been opened, so the crystal formation inside is unknown.

Condition: Unopened and intact. Loose sandy grit and a few small stone crumbs inside the wrap. Small pink paint mark on the surface.

277656943.description: Vintage clear glass oil lamp featuring a hexagonal glass base and a tall clear glass chimney. The lamp measures approximately 11 inches tall. It is a collectible item suitable for display or use.  Related vintage items include glass insulators, oil lamps, hand warmers, washboards, Ball Mason jars, and other collectibles.
